input.command:
python3 -c "
import cv2, numpy as np

# Let's inspect obs_0013 and obs_0018 to find the floor contact / base center of floor lamp
# Floor lamp base is a dark circle on the floor
for f_id in [13, 18]:
    img = cv2.imread(f'/work/observations/obs_{f_id:04d}.png')
    # base is dark grey, around x=200..300, y=350..450
    # Let's find lowest dark pixels of lamp base:
    b, g, r = img[:,:,0], img[:,:,1], img[:,:,2]
    lamp_base = (r > 50) & (r < 90) & (g > 60) & (g < 100) & (b > 70) & (b < 110)
    ys, xs = np.where(lamp_base)
    if len(ys) > 0:
        print(f'obs_{f_id}: base y in [{ys.min()}, {ys.max()}], x in [{xs.min()}, {xs.max()}], center=({xs.mean():.1f}, {ys.mean():.1f})')
"
